_status: READ-ONLY two-token book-state shadow collector. Records BOTH outcome tokens' books independently (never one token with a derived complement) plus L5's public activity, on one append-only JSONL tape with per-row provenance. Public endpoints, GET only, websocket subscribe only, no credentials required and none logged. Blocking boot gate fails if any order-capable module is importable. One shared pacer caps the WHOLE process at BOOK_SHADOW_MAX_RPM (default 240 req/min) and backs off on HTTP 429. Must NOT be deployed to the service running an armed probe.
